scope: Fake-only direct call of exact V5 point-mint method; unrelated session_v32 parent is stubbed to avoid importing legacy Calc/UI dependencies; no desktop, browser, provider, or input dispatch
cases: process generation changes; window generation, focus, surface, geometry and pixels stay constant
window generation changes; process generation, focus, surface, geometry and pixels stay constant
same process/window generations, focus, surface, geometry and pixels
acceptance: Both negatives raise DecisionRequired with no TargetHandleStore entry; positive mints one session alias backed by a private registry ID and records exact same source/fresh patch SHA-256.
retry_policy: One normal and one -O run only; retain all outcomes.
